people.name: Hamonah
people.line: A city in Ezekiel's vision, meaning "multitude" or "horde."

translations.web: Hamonah will also be the name of a city. Thus they will cleanse the land.” ’
translations.bsb: (Even the city will be named Hamonah.) And so they will cleanse the land.
